parsed.observations: Wheat leaves show scattered white to grey-white surface patches, including powdery-looking colonies on the central upright leaf and the leaf held by hand. Water droplets and some lower-leaf yellowing are also visible. No colored rust pustules or black-dotted necrotic blotches are evident.
parsed.summary: Visible white to grey-white powdery surface colonies on wheat leaves support powdery mildew.
